text:
Alyssa: opened PR to update model catalog entry for zephyr-aurora v1.2. Main goals: add int8 variant docs, per-variant context limits, migration notes, and new SDK snippets (py/node/go/curl). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4191
Ben: nice. Quick heads up: runtime accepts `quantize_profile` (string) not `quantize: true`. Also variant names are `zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8` and `zephyr-aurora-v1.2-fp16`.
Carmen: I'll drop the bench table in the PR comment shortly. We should include p50/p95 for 512/2048/4096 sequences and a small note about quality delta for int8.
Alyssa: plan to include a small table and link to the raw benchmark repo for details. Also want to surface behavior when context >4096.
Ben: runtime behavior: requests >4096 token default route to the longseq-compatible variant `zephyr-aurora-v1.2-longseq`. Add sentence: "Requests that exceed a variant's max_context will be routed to a compatible variant when available; latency may increase."
Docs Bot: Template checker: model-card template has link /docs/model-catalog/compatibility which 404s. Recommend /docs/compat/matrix.
Alyssa: thanks, will update link and add redirect note.
Ben: small API snippet suggestion. Python (concise):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${RW_KEY}")
resp = client.generate(model="zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8", input="Summarize...", options={"quantize_profile": "int8", "max_tokens": 256})
print(resp.text)
```
Node example (short):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8', input: '...', options: { quantize_profile: 'int8', max_tokens: 256 } })
console.log(resp.text)
```
Go snippet (new):
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
res, _ := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateRequest{ Model: "zephyr-aurora-v1.2-int8", Input: "...", Options: map[string]interface{}{ "quantize_profile": "int8", "max_tokens": 256 }, })
fmt.Println(res.Text)
```
Alyssa: adding all three. Also adding a curl example for quick checks.
Carmen: pasted bench numbers: 512 seq p50 int8 34ms / fp16 28ms; 2048 seq p50 int8 86ms / fp16 68ms; 4096 seq p50 int8 170ms (falls back to longseq variant for some combinations). Added throughput (tokens/s) too.
Ben: nit: update the limits table to show per-variant max_context (int8: 4096, fp16: 8192, longseq: 16384). Otherwise customers will be confused.
Alyssa: will change table to include per-variant columns and note which variant is default for hosted vs dedicated.
Docs Bot: CI: docs linter found a formatting issue in the markdown table (unequal columns). Suggest running `npm run docs:lint` before pushing.
Alyssa: running lint locally, fixing table.
CI Bot: preview built: https://deploy-previews.internal.redwood/4191 (staging)
Carmen: one more thing 01 - quality note for int8: small increase in hallucination rate on longer contexts (>2k) for certain spans. I'll attach a short blurb and link to regression tests.
Alyssa: added DRAFT bench table and "quality note (DRAFT)" section labeled clearly. Will mark PR as needs-tests until Carmen's regression tests land.
Ben: after merge, recommend a changelog entry: "zephyr-aurora v1.2: int8 variant + longseq routing + per-variant limits". Also update SDK changelog snippets.
Alyssa: will add changelog. Thank you all 7ec :thumbsup:
